page.layout: One page: title page, centred. Top: small spaced "D E", then large capitals "STAVROLATRIA", spaced capitals "ROMANA", and "Libri Duo". Below: a block of faint italic lines (partly mirrored show-through). Then the author's name in large capitals, a line of capitals, and small italic lines. Lower down: a faint printer's device and the imprint lines at the foot.
page.notes: Show-through from the reverse side makes the faint italic lines and the imprint largely unreadable; those lines are marked illegible. The printer's device in the centre is an engraving and is not transcribed. "M. DC. XXI." at the foot is doubtful [?]. The author's name line reads "CONRADI DECKHERI" with the first letters faint. "IVLIACENSIS" is printed with the old I/J-V forms, here normalised to the Latin letters as required.
